annotations.title: Create a paused lead or message campaign

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta Instant Form lead campaign (goal lead_generation, the ad set's leadGenFormId from ads_lead_forms_list, placements without Audience Network, the age range and countries in targeting) with one image ad, or video ads, created PAUSED. It lands in the owner's Proposed campaigns and never runs or spends until the owner approves it (ads_campaign_approve). headline, body, one creative and budget (dollars; budgetType daily or lifetime) are required. The creative is one of: imageUrl (https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com; anything else, upload it with POST /api/v2/media/upload-url), imageMediaId (that upload's storageId), creativeId, video, or videos (several video ads in one ad set for an A/B test, each { mediaId | contentId | metaVideoId, name?, thumbnailUrl? }). placements: automatic (default), facebook, instagram, facebook_instagram, feeds, reels, stories, or { platforms, surfaces }; never Audience Network. savedTargetingId reuses a saved audience (Ads > Audiences) under your own targeting; interest ids come from ads_targeting_search. promotedObject.pageId picks the Facebook Page. goal messages instead creates a click-to-message ad (Messenger + Instagram Direct, imageUrl only, no form): the brand's automatic first reply greets people with quick replies tagged with armKey, and each conversation lands as a lead with its ad/arm attribution; also PAUSED and proposed. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns.)

adAccountId.description: Default: the brand's selected ad account; must match it.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

aiDisclosure.description: Mark the video ads as AI-generated (set automatically for flayr AI videos).

armKey.description: messages only: the test arm in each quick-reply payload and lead (default: from the headline).

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

callToAction.description: A CTA from the ads create config (default: the owner's default, e.g. LEARN_MORE; SIGN_UP suits a lead form).

creativeId.description: lead_generation only: a saved ad creative id instead of imageUrl.

goal.description: lead_generation (Instant Form) or messages (click-to-message, Messenger + Instagram Direct).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key return the first result instead of creating twice.

imageMediaId.description: lead_generation only: a flayr upload (the storageId POST /api/v2/media/upload-url returns) instead of imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: The ad image, https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com. For any other image, upload it and send imageMediaId. Send exactly one of imageUrl, imageMediaId, creativeId, video, videos.

leadGenFormId.description: lead_generation only, and required there: an Instant Form id (GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms).

placements.description: Default automatic = Facebook, Instagram and Messenger. Audience Network is never used. feeds/reels/stories (or { surfaces }) pick those positions on Facebook and Instagram.

promotedObject.description: The Facebook Page the lead ad runs from.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

savedTargetingId.description: lead_generation only: a saved audience id (the id in the Ads > Audiences page URL). Its targeting is the base; fields in `targeting` override it.

schedule.description: ISO dates; default now to +7 days.

targeting.description: Age range 13-65 and the usual targeting fields.

video.description: lead_generation only: one video ad. Exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId.

mediaId.description: A flayr upload (the storageId of POST /api/v2/media/upload-url).

metaVideoId.description: A video already in the Meta ad account.

name.description: The ad name (default: the headline, numbered when there are several).

videos.description: lead_generation only: several video ads in the same ad set (an A/B test), up to the ads create config cap (default 6). Each is created PAUSED; one that fails to attach is reported in `ads` and does not undo the campaign.

items.description: Exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId.

mediaId.description: A flayr upload (the storageId of POST /api/v2/media/upload-url).

metaVideoId.description: A video already in the Meta ad account.

name.description: The ad name (default: the headline, numbered when there are several).
